sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Changes first-run defaults: hides the Image, Video, Audio and Cleaner tabs, and shows hidden files by default. Only affects users who have never changed the setting themselves - the preference override still takes priority.
Prevents the in-app rate-us dialog from ever being shown.
Forces the ad-removed/Pro check to always return true, and renames the launcher activity from SplashActivity to MainActivity so the splash screen is skipped.
